AI Sovereignty
The AI Sovereignty Scorecard

Can your organization make its own choices as AI becomes part of its business?

AI sovereignty is your organization’s ability to make, carry out, and revise its own choices as it adopts AI. It depends on control over data and technology, the capacity for independent human judgment, and the ability to change course. Assess your organization across these four dimensions with sixteen questions about its current practices. Allow about ten minutes.

This scorecard is part of a research study, and you receive your own results.
